run_kilt_nq_main: run the Kilt_NQ main function to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_kilt_nq_dataset: create a Kilt_NQ dataset instance that loads the KILT HotpotQA HuggingFace dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with tab-joined answers
load_kilt_hotpotqa: load the KILT HotpotQA dataset from HuggingFace using the kilt_tasks hotpotqa config
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits with a specified seed and output path
